Kraus Hamdani Aerospace | Software Engineer | REMOTE (US) or ONSITE in Reno, NV

We build long-endurance autonomous aircraft and the software used to operate them.

Looking for a strong generalist software engineer. Most application work is TypeScript/web, with C/C++ and Rust elsewhere in the stack. You’ll work across frontend, backend, cloud, DevOps, and directly with flight test and hardware teams.

We care a lot about code quality, maintainability, and engineers who can take ambiguous problems and independently ship solid software. No sloppers.

U.S. defense/security eligibility required.

Apply: software@khaero.com
